sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Seal 340010: two-year full-volume renewal proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We understand your capacity concern and propose a structure that gives you planning certainty:
- EUR 29.89/unit
- 23,400 units/year, firm
- 24 months from 2027-01-01
- 56 days lead time
Payment 30 days, DAP, no index clause, no tooling charge.

Our recent orders for this seal, po:4500014383-10 and po:4500014436-10, were both placed at EUR 29.89/unit. Two years of firm full volume and 56 days of scheduling room should help you plan capacity for our full allocation.

If this does not yet work for you, what adjustment would make it work?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 340010: two-year full-volume renewal proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. While historical prices are acknowledged, they are not applicable to current allocations given our high capacity utilisation. We note your proposal for a 24-month term at 23,400 units per year. Based on the extended contract duration and increased volume, we revise our offer to a price of €31.90 per unit. 

Our revised Angebot comprises a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm (part:340010) – three-year commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for moving to the full 23,400 units and 24 months. To bridge the remaining gap, we propose a reciprocal trade:
- EUR 30.10/unit
- 23,400 units/year, firm
- 36 months from 2027-01-01
- 56 days lead time
Payment 30 days, DAP, no index clause, no tooling charge.

We raise our price and add a third year of firm commitment. In return, we ask for a lower unit price than EUR 31.90 and a firm full allocation. Our buyer estimate for this seal (cost:340010) is EUR 24.31 excluding margin, with about 5% uncertainty. It is our own estimate, not a statement about your actual costs. We ask you to consider it together with this longer commitment.

Can you work with this structure? If not, what would you need to adjust?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm (part:340010) – three-year commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your cost estimate and the proposed 36-month contract term. While your estimate is acknowledged, our pricing reflects the current market and our high capacity utilisation. Furthermore, our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Based on the extended 36-month commitment, we revise our offer to a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. 

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
